title: Max's Robot
text:
Max has a robot. It is silver and very fast. It can walk and talk.

Max plays with the robot after school. His dad helps him fix it. They are happy together.

questions.text: When does Max play with the robot?
Why does Max's dad help him?
How does Max probably feel about his robot?

vocabulary.definition: a machine that can move and do some tasks by itself
having the light grey colour of a metal such as the metal silver

paragraph_translations: У Макса є робот. Він срібний і дуже швидкий. Він вміє ходити і говорити.
Макс грає з роботом після школи. Його тато допомагає йому полагодити робота. Їм разом весело.
